newsitem.title: USA: PRESS DIGEST - Daily Variety - January 8.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Daily Variety - January 8.

text.p: The following stories appeared in Wednesday's edition of Daily Variety:
HOLLYWOOD - ABC Entertainment chairman Ted Harbert, who started at ABC some 20 years ago, is leaving the network on February 15. ABC is a unit of Walt Disney Co.
HOLLYWOOD - A hefty contingent of top-selling artists mixed with critical favourites to round out the nominations for the 39th annual Grammy Awards, announced on Tuesday in New York.

NEW YORK - Viacom Inc will write off $100 million against its fourth-quarter profit to cover the costs of closing 50 unprofitable Blockbuster Music stores, wiping out the entertainment giant's quarterly profit.

HOLLYWOOD - Robert De Niro is in talks to star with Billy Crystal in Warner Bros' Analyze This, a comedy Crystal developed at the studio that will be directed by Richard Loncraine. Warner Bros is part of Time Warner Inc.
HOLLYWOOD - Mike Hope, executive vice-president of MGM Inc, has resigned after three years with the company.
